mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.from_user_id, r.to_user_id, r.status, r.remark, r.create_time, u.nickname AS from_nickname, u.avatar AS from_avatar FROM chat_friend_request r LEFT JOIN chat_user u ON u.id = r.from_user_id WHERE r.to_user_id = #{toUserId} AND r.status = 'pending' ORDER BY r.create_time DESC
